A little guidance

Frontal or closure?

Not sure which one is right for you? Our illustrated guide helps you compare the look, styling flexibility and upkeep before arranging your appointment.

A closure

Covers a smaller section at the front of the wig. It can suit a simple, polished look with less styling around the hairline and is usually easier to maintain.

A frontal

Extends from ear to ear, giving more flexibility with parting and styling around the hairline.

Explore the illustrated guide · 6 slides

Tap any slide to open the full-size image. A readable explanation appears beneath each image.

The right choice is personal.

Neither is automatically better. Tell us about your preferred style and maintenance routine, and we can discuss the options with you.
